node.title: Re: Forcing list context. Brackets (with list within) as an unary right-associative operator
node.author: choroba
node.doctext:
Interesting. Definitely a bug in Perl, but it seems it's been already fixed: $ blead perl -wle '$_ = "abcdefgh"; print "2" . ( m/./g )[()]' Use of uninitialized value in concatenation (.) or string at -e line 1. 2
